name: Synn
message: 「Good luck! Now then, I've got my bento and--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't show me! I'll lose my appetite.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I'll give you this as an apology. Here, some rolled omelet.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, me? W-Wait, I haven't even eaten anything yet.」

name: Synn
message: 「Did it fill up during the morning classes?」

name: Azel
message: 「That's right. I took a ton of photos in the class having study hall.」

name: Synn
message: 「Break time is one thing, but you shouldn't skip class.」

name: Synn
message: 「Before that, you're a student at Ryuusei Academy, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「Make sure you go to class, okay.」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, you really ought to learn how to at least transfer data from a digital camera by yourself.」

name: Azel
message: 「If you can do it, there's no problem.」

name: Misa
message: 「There is a problem... You're having Vandine Jelly again today, Azel.」

name: Synn
message: 「Not wrong, but you won't grow big eating a meal like that.」

name: Misa
message: 「Mind your own business. I'm on a diet.」

name: Synn
message: 「You look lonely, so I'll give you some milk.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come quietly and let me tie you up, damn it!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Huff, huff... Climbing the stairs makes my head spin.」

name: Synn
message: 「Transfer complete. Now then, guess I'll have my bento too.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So that's what's going on... Azel, learn how to at least transfer data already.」

name: Azel
message: 「He can do it, so there's no problem.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeah, right? Since there's actually someone who can do it, you should just let him do it for you.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「When guys are relied on, it really hits them right in the heart.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, let me copy today's math assignment!」

name: Synn
message: 「Do it yourself once in a while.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, it didn't hit him in the heart at all!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「See, it really hit him right in the heart.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, I'm gonna drink some milk too!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Aah, instead of hitting her in the heart, it hit her right in the stomach.」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder why? Even though it's so good...」
